text:
Nina: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to @Jules and Facilities for rescuing the new office cactus and restocking croissants this morning. You saved my demo and my breakfast :raised_hands:
Jules: lol the cactus is alive! just a bit of soil drama after that sudden wind blast in the meeting room. glad the croissants arrived in time :cactus: :croissant:
Chris: big thanks from me too — demo went smoothly once the plant was upright. extra almond croissant was a bold choice, 10/10 :clap:
Devon: ran to the bakery between standups. if anyone asks, my sprint plan included pastries today :sweat_smile:
FacilitiesBot: [automated] Camera sensor detected toppled object at 09:12, maintenance ticket #4721 created and assigned to Jules. Coffee machine cycle resumed at 09:34.
Nina: also, massive thanks to @FacilitiesBot for the quick heads-up. saved us from awkward cleanup mid-demo :grimacing:
Ops: shoutout to the impromptu triage team — Jules, Devon, and Facilities. small moments like this keep the office vibes great. :sparkles: :trophy:
Jules: team effort. also left a note next to the cactus: "No more standing ovations pls" :memo:
Chris: can we get a tiny sign for all fragile plants? 3x3 printed. i'll volunteer to design it if it helps :pencil2:
Devon: i'll pick up supplies tomorrow. sticky-backed signs, maybe a little joke.
Nina: perfect — thanks everyone. coffee and croissant fund owed to the heroes of the hour :coffee: :croissant: :heart:
